name: Plank
summary: An isometric bodyweight core exercise held in a prone position supported on the forearms and toes to resist spinal extension.

setup: Lie prone on the floor or an exercise mat.
Place your elbows directly beneath your shoulders with forearms resting flat on the ground, pointing forward.
Tuck your toes under and extend your legs fully.
steps: Engage your abdominals and glutes to lift your torso, hips, and thighs off the floor.
Form a rigid, straight line from your heels through your hips to the top of your head.
Press the floor away through your forearms to maintain active shoulder protraction without sagging.
Hold the position steadily for the intended duration without letting your lower back arch or hips pike.
Lower your knees and body smoothly to the floor to finish.
instructions.breathing: Breathe continuously with slow, controlled breaths into your belly while maintaining steady core tension.

common_faults.correction: Squeeze your glutes, tilt your pelvis slightly posterior, and brace your abs to align hips with shoulders.

common_faults.fault: Piking hips upward to relieve core tension.
common_faults.correction: Lower your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to heels.

common_faults.fault: Winged scapulae and collapsing into the shoulders.
common_faults.correction: Actively press your forearms into the floor to keep your upper back broad.

precautions: Terminate the hold when you can no longer prevent lumbar extension or hip sagging.
